review:
A hunting trip on paylines. Hunting Season symbols start a Hunt where five shots are fired, and any animals hit turn into coins or traps. Stars on the animals set the minimum coin type, traps collect every coin and trap on screen, and wilds on hit reels add multipliers.

Three FS give 10 spins with more Hunts; four give 10 where animals in regular wins gain stars that carry over; five unlock the hidden Epic bonus with a Hunt every spin. Rated 3/5, 5,000x max, RTP from 96.33% down to 86.25%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.25% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
